fields.label: Account
fields.description: Any root type — unlike a P&L source row, a cash flow line legitimately binds a Liability account (a loan, a payable) or an Equity account (dividends), not only Income/Expense.

fields.label: Direction Mode
fields.description: Net: every cash-leg movement on this account counts. Debit Only / Credit Only: only movements in that direction count — the setting that lets 'Riyadh Bank Loan settlement' (Debit Only) and 'Financing from Riyadh Bank' (Credit Only) read the SAME liability account as two distinct, non-overlapping lines instead of one net figure.

fields.label: Cost Center
fields.description: Set when the parent line's Dimension field is Cost Center. Narrows this binding to GL Entries carrying this exact cost centre — how 'Audit' and 'HR' read from the same shared receivables account as two different lines.

fields.label: Project
fields.description: Set when the parent line's Dimension field is Project.

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Employee / Supplier / Customer — set together with Party when several lines share one account and are told apart only by who the transaction is with (e.g. four management-fee lines on one Payable account, one per person).
